Triage: lands in `area:ux` · `domain:ui` · `priority:p2` · Bug · `pm:queue` · size XS.
Rationale: an approver cannot tell why a bulk action left some rows undone. The UX rule gives p2, because this does not reach every user every time, and UX has no p3. Seat 3 takes the card, as its request said.

repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

Delivered (2026-11-25T17:12Z): PR #37282 merged (2026-11-25T17:07Z), landed by the seat after the maintainer's approval (narrowing hand-off 7165958218). This card was closed by its `Fixes #36855`.

A bulk approve or reject in the Approval Center that partly fails now says why each row failed. The toast reads "N succeeded, M failed" and lists the first three failed rows as "title: reason", and it stays until dismissed. With more failures it carries "Show all (M)", which opens a dialog listing every failed row and reason; each toast keeps its own run's list. The reason is the server's `userMessage`, else the page's line for the refusal, else the error's own text, else "Action failed".

`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`: `approvalsInbox.bulkPartial` is retired in all 11 packs, listed under "Removed translation keys". A follow-up for a run that ends after leaving the page is filed separately. Nothing is left on this card; `pm:dispatched` removed.
